title: director.interrupts/1
description: data/director/interrupts.json: control-scheme step 3 (ADR 0008; control-rules.md sections 1, 2 and 6): the costs, cooldowns and windows of what a fighter does inside an exchange, read by sim/director/interrupt.gd (DirInterrupt). Ticks are sim ticks (60 a second); ki is out of 100. Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore; every key required except the window classes (a class not listed has no window). Orders (a brawl flurry's minGap at most its maxGap its mul gaps strictly increasing, its runLapseTicks below its tradeMaxTicks, and a heavy's heldFullTicks at most its heldMaxTicks (brawl-order); a walk's minTicks at most its maxTicks; the split's width and power shares at most 1, a warning; kiPatient at most ki; the stale maximums are at least one repeat's step; a one-armed blocker keeps a window; light at most heavy; a window not longer than its wind-up, a warning) are checked by tools/lib/xref-fight.js (interrupts-*).

beam.description: The last ticks of a beam's tell in which a fresh guard press is a perfect block against it.

blow.description: The last ticks of a brawl blow's wind-up in which a fresh guard press is a perfect block against it.

windows.description: The last ticks of the wind-up in which a fresh guard press is a perfect block, by strike class (moveset-rules.md section 11(f)); a class not listed has no window.

early.description: Ticks before the window opens in which a press still counts, by class.

oneArmedOff.description: Ticks off every window for a blocker with a broken arm.

gapTicks.description: The defender may cancel only this long after it was last struck (a gap between strikes, never hit-stun).

dash.description: The speed of the dash in the held direction, units a second.

freeBeforeWindup.description: The attacker's cancel costs nothing until his first wind-up starts (agency-pass.md section 1, solution E).

freeGapTicks.description: Then it starts this many ticks of cooldown, and not cooldownTicks.

rangeBh.description: A rival within this many body heights is shoved.

threatTicks.description: A fighter struck within this long is being hit, so a power press bursts at once.

autoLink.description: The chain link at which a Simple-layout slot bursts when it pressed nothing.

kiPatient.description: The ki after patientTicks of continuous guard.

behindTicks.description: A string blocked to its end leaves the attacker unable to act for this long.

after.description: The same weight, mode and direction in this many exchanges running.

midBh.description: Mid band: to this many body heights; far beyond.

engageBh.description: A press from farther off starts only the approach, which ends this far from the rival.

minTicks.description: The approach lasts at least this many whole ticks.

light.description: Ticks of wind-up before a light lunge.

heavy.description: Ticks of wind-up before a heavy lunge.

windupTicks.description: The lunge's wind-up by the blow's weight.

lunge.description: The mid band's approach: the distance to cover at `speed`, in whole ticks between minTicks and maxTicks.

minTicks.description: The approach lasts at least this many whole ticks.

light.description: The far band's approach for a light press.

minTicks.description: The approach lasts at least this many whole ticks.

far.description: The far band, by the press's weight.

windowTicks.description: The ticks the taunt's window stays open.

holdTicks.description: The ticks the press is held to count as a charge.

holdTicks.description: The ticks the press is held to count as a charge.

minTicks.description: At least this many whole ticks.

enabled.description: false: a beam is decided at its fire beat, as before.

ticks.description: The defender's own signature or heavy energy attack within this many ticks of the fire stops the beam in a struggle.
